status: registered before execution; leave-one-event-out (LOEO) training of the arrival-time head
question: Does a single-observation temporal-contrast head generalise to an UNSEEN landslide event when it is trained on THREE other events (instead of one), at tile-level pre-event false-alarm budgets set on the pooled validation of the training events?
folds: 4 LOEO folds: hold out one event, train on all tiles of the other three (10% of training tiles by hash as validation for the threshold), test on all tiles of the held-out event
data: arrival_v0/<event>/single_fp16 (15 single-observation states per tile), sealed masks, meta (post_index, clear)
head: 1x1-conv head (768->128->1, bilinear to 128) on the single-observation state normalised with the hiroshima sealed train stats (fixed across folds); temporal-contrast labels (pre-event steps weighted to match post-event steps; negatives included); 30 epochs AdamW 1e-3; seed 1
reference_arms: prefix (causal full re-encoding) + frozen sealed readout of the held-out event's own LOCO fold (resolution_contract_v2/p4_native_control/holdout_<event>_seed1) — the cross-region readout that legitimately never saw the held-out region
budget: tile-level 5% and 10% on the pooled validation tiles of the training events; realised pre-event FAR on the held-out event reported; validity = realised FAR < 3x budget
metrics: per fold: realised FAR, confirmation rate, never-confirmed, latency A/B medians, post-event mean IoU
event-level: number of folds (of 4) where the LOEO head is valid with confirmation >= 70% at the 10% budget and post-event IoU >= the frozen prefix reference on that event

decision_rules.generalises: >= 3 of 4 folds valid with confirmation >= 70% at 10% budget; then the arrival-time head claim (0-step latency) is restored on multi-event evidence
decision_rules.partial: 2 of 4: report as event-dependent; no method claim
decision_rules.fails: <= 1 of 4: the arrival-time detector for the VLM track is fixed to the frozen cross-region readout; the head line is closed

not_claimed: anything beyond four Sentinel-2 landslide events
label-budget parity with the sealed readout
